durable_authority_operation_ledger.payload_identity: SHA-256 of P0-validated closed request DTO canonical JCS bytes, including every request field
durable_authority_operation_ledger.persistence: Store payload_hash, first success HTTP status and exact typed response JSON in the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as the authority mutation.

typed_publication.h_b: PublicationReceipt has only publication_id,candidate_id,revision_id; operation key binds only candidate_id; implementation is document-only.
typed_publication.execution_tx: If independently accepted and merged first, accept_in_transaction adds useful single-transaction Event/execution binding behavior, but still returns the narrow receipt, does not bind workspace_id+accepted_by+candidate_id as the full command, exposes no replay boolean, and does not cover every frozen entity_kind.

typed_publication.idempotent_semantics: First committed response has idempotent=false; same-key/same-command replay returns the same publication/revision identities with idempotent=true; different command payload returns operation_key_reuse.
typed_publication.plugin_boundary: No Publication callable may be added to plugin SDK/RPC/UI Bundle. Only Core-native service and Core-rendered confirmation may invoke it.

malformed_ingress.existing_v1_boundary: core-http-error/v1 remains the domain failure envelope declared by core-api-method-matrix/v1; its enum/status bindings are not edited or reinterpreted.
malformed_ingress.scope: P0 maps malformed JSON, unknown fields, closed-schema failures and invalid integer query syntax before invoking P1 authority. No FastAPI default 422 body may escape for /api/v1/core/**.
malformed_ingress.version_reason: This is a new pre-domain request-failure family for inputs that cannot produce a valid v1 request/result, not a mutation of any published v1 DTO or route-domain error family.

asset_range.h_b: AssetStore.describe/read can provide metadata and bounded bytes. Execution TX create_asset/read_asset/require adds no HTTP range semantics.
semantics: For 0 <= offset < total_size, length is a requested maximum; return min(length,total_size-offset) bytes, echo the request offset, and hash exactly the decoded returned chunk.
For offset == total_size, return HTTP 200 with offset=total_size,length=0,empty base64,next_offset=null,content_hash=SHA256(empty bytes).
For offset > total_size, return HTTP 400 core-http-request-error/v1 range_out_of_bounds; do not invent 416 or misuse unknown_reference/cross_workspace.
The endpoint remains the published JSON/base64 query; it does not implement Range headers, 206 or Content-Range.

etag.semantics: No ETag, If-None-Match, 304 or If-Range behavior is promised or emitted by this v1 adapter. asset-metadata/v1.sha256 is the immutable whole-object hash; asset-read-range/v1.content_hash is the exact returned chunk hash.
etag.future_change: Any HTTP ETag/conditional/RFC Range feature requires a new versioned public contract and ADR; P1 must not invent it in this node.
